tagline.en: Malaysia's biggest network: 95-country roaming passes, free SMS reception in China
tagline.zh: 马来西亚最大的网络：95 国漫游包，在中国免费收短信

description.en: CelcomDigi prepaid (the classic "purple SIM") runs on Malaysia's largest merged Celcom-Digi network. The 30-Day Unlimited roaming pass (3GB daily high-speed + unlimited 1Mbps) covers 95 countries including China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, US and UK at RM118 on postpaid — but prepaid is split (effective 2026-05-21): RM118 covers 76 countries, and China sits in a 5-country RM148 tier (Brunei, China, Oman, Turkey, UAE). Receiving SMS while roaming in mainland China is free with zero balance — its core keep-alive value. Since the 2022-2023 merger, everything moved to celcomdigi.com, the CelcomDigi app, and *118#/*124# USSD menus.
description.zh: CelcomDigi 预付卡（经典"紫卡"）运行在 Celcom 与 Digi 合并后的马来西亚最大网络上。30 天无限漫游包（每日 3GB 高速+无限 1Mbps）在后付费下 RM118 覆盖含中国、香港、日本、韩国、英美在内的 95 国——但预付费已拆档（2026-05-21 生效）：RM118 仅覆盖 76 国，中国属于 RM148 的 5 国档（文莱、中国、阿曼、土耳其、阿联酋）。在中国大陆漫游接收短信免费、零余额即可收到——这是它保号场景的核心价值。2022-2023 合并后，所有操作迁移到 celcomdigi.com、CelcomDigi app 与 *118#/*124# 指令。

details.en:
Celcom (founded 1988, Malaysia's oldest operator) merged with Digi to form CelcomDigi Berhad (reg. 425190-X), the country's largest carrier — 20M+ subscribers, 98% population coverage. Old purple prepaid SIMs keep working in the new system.

**China roaming in practice**: SMS reception is free on insertion; data attaches to China Mobile / China Unicom 4G (5G requires prior local Malaysian activation). The classic APN trap survives: Androids defaulting to a "celcom4g" APN stick on EDGE — switch APN to celcom3g and toggle airplane mode. Voice is expensive (RM6/min incoming, up to RM12/min outgoing): treat it as a data-and-SMS card.

**2026 roaming passes (one-time, prepaid-eligible; effective 2026-05-21, re-verified via help.celcomdigi.com 2026-09-16)**: RM28/3 days 4GB (SG/ID/TH only); RM48/3 days, RM58/7 days (2GB daily), RM98/14 days, RM128/10 days (1GB-country list: Afghanistan, Fiji, Iran, Macedonia, Maldives, Mauritius, Mongolia, Morocco, Panama, PNG, Samoa, Tajikistan, Tonga, Turks & Caicos, Vanuatu, Yemen), RM118/30 days (3GB daily, unlimited 1Mbps) — each with 15 min voice and AeroMobile in-flight roaming. Coverage: the multi-country passes span 95 countries on postpaid; on prepaid the 30-day pass splits to RM118/76 countries with China in the RM148 tier (Brunei, China, Oman, Turkey, UAE). Postpaid 5G 120+ subscribers get 50% off and monthly options (RM40/30GB 3-country, RM70/80GB 95-country); prepaid is one-time-pass only.

**Keep-alive rules changed post-merger**. Reload extends validity by amount: RM5=5d, RM10=10d, RM30=30d, RM50=50d, RM100=100d (Digi side: 120d). After credit expiry a 50-day grace period allows top-up only. Super Long Life extensions via *118#: RM1/1d, RM2/3d, RM8/15d (Celcom) and RM108/365d on Digi plans (validity T&C pages were CloudFront-geo-blocked from the 2026-09 audit egress — rules per the 2026-08-22 verification with no contradicting source; re-verify from a MY IP or the app). Credit caps at RM1,000; reloads carry a 6% service tax.

**eKYC is mandatory**: passport photo + liveness check at activation. Buy from sellers who complete registration with your own passport where possible — pre-registered SIMs carry reclaim risk. An un-eKYC'd SIM shows no signal in China; *124# responding confirms registration took. Sources: celcomdigi.com roaming pages + third-party tests, verified 2026-08-22.
details.zh:
Celcom（1988 年成立，马来西亚最老牌运营商）与 Digi 合并组建 CelcomDigi Berhad（注册号 425190-X），为马来西亚用户量最大的运营商——2000 万+用户、98% 人口覆盖。老紫卡在新体系下继续可用。

**中国漫游实测**：插卡即免费收短信；数据走中国移动/联通 4G（5G 需先在马来西亚本地开通激活）。经典 APN 坑依旧存在：安卓默认 "celcom4g" APN 会卡 EDGE——改成 celcom3g 再开关飞行模式即可。通话很贵（接听 RM6/分钟、拨打最高 RM12/分钟），把它当流量+收码卡用。

**2026 漫游包（一次性，预付可买；2026-05-21 生效，2026-09-16 经 help.celcomdigi.com 复核）**：RM28/3天 4GB（仅新印泰）；RM48/3天、RM58/7天（每日 2GB）、RM98/14天、RM128/10天（1GB国家档：阿富汗、斐济、伊朗、马其顿、马尔代夫、毛里求斯、蒙古、摩洛哥、巴拿马、巴新、萨摩亚、塔吉克斯坦、汤加、特克斯和凯科斯、瓦努阿图、也门）、RM118/30天（每日 3GB+无限 1Mbps）——各含 15 分钟通话与 AeroMobile 机上漫游。覆盖面：多国包后付费为 95 国；预付费的 30 天包拆为 RM118/76 国，中国属 RM148 档（文莱、中国、阿曼、土耳其、阿联酋）。后付 5G 120 及以上套餐半价且有月付选项（RM40/30GB 三国、RM70/80GB 95国）；预付只能买一次性包。

**保号规则合并后已改**。充值按额延期：RM5=5天、RM10=10天、RM30=30天、RM50=50天、RM100=100天（Digi 侧 120 天）。余额过期后有 50 天宽限期（仅可充值）。Super Long Life 延期走 *118#：RM1/1天、RM2/3天、RM8/15天（Celcom 侧），Digi 套餐另有 RM108/365天（有效期条款页对2026-09审计出口IP为CloudFront地区屏蔽——规则按2026-08-22核验口径、未见矛盾来源；建议从马来西亚IP或App内复核）。余额上限 RM1,000；充值含 6% 服务税。

**eKYC 强制实名**：激活需护照拍照+人脸识别。尽量选用自己的护照完成注册的渠道——预实名的卡有被原持有人找回的风险。未完成 eKYC 的卡在国内无信号；*124# 能回即实名成功。来源：celcomdigi.com 漫游页+第三方实测，核验于 2026-08-22。

plansNote.en: Pass catalogue REPLACED effective 1 Oct 2026 — old RM28–RM148 passes discontinued; new prepaid High-Speed passes from RM10 and Monthly Roaming Passes RM40/RM70 per official help articles (re-verified 2026-11-03; main site geo-blocked, verified via help.celcomdigi.com articles). plansNote.zh: 漫游包目录已于 2026-10-01 整体更换：原 RM28–RM148 各档停售；新预付高速包 RM10 起、月度漫游包 RM40/RM70（2026-11-03 依官方帮助文章复核；主站地区屏蔽，经帮助中心核验）。漫游包价格核验自 help.celcomdigi.com「Roaming Passes (Effective date 21 May 2026)」（2026-09-16；主站对审计出口IP地区屏蔽）；预付30天包 RM118/76国 与 RM148 中国档在该页确认。有效期规则依据 CelcomDigi 预付条款与马来西亚预付卡终止规则（50 天宽限期）——条款页2026-09被地区屏蔽，规则沿用2026-08-22核验口径、未见矛盾来源。RM1 ≈ USD 0.21。

note.en: CelcomDigi Berhad is Malaysia's largest mobile operator; its subscriber IPs are Malaysian carrier mobile IPs — multiple mobile-proxy vendors (QuanticData, QuantumProxies, VoidMob) explicitly source real CelcomDigi 4G/5G IPs from live handsets, confirming country=MY, type=mobile.
note.zh: CelcomDigi 为马来西亚最大移动运营商，用户出口 IP 为马来西亚运营商移动 IP——多家移动代理商（QuanticData、QuantumProxies、VoidMob）明确以真机 CelcomDigi 4G/5G IP 为货源，确认国家=MY、性质=mobile。
